title: CHU-B strike continues through the 23 December government statement

start_date.summary: The ACI article confirms talks with CHU-B agents but does not independently establish the start; cross-unit Adiac source COB11S002 reports 29 Oct.

end_date.summary: Government spokesperson on 23 Dec said negotiations remained ongoing and minimum service was operating.

notes: Collective labor dispute continuity, not a verified public protest. Cross-unit start ref: congo_brazzaville_2024-11 / COB11S002.

title: UMNG strike ends after approximately three months

end_date.summary: ACI reports the intersyndical announced the end on 27 Dec and course resumption from 30 Dec.

start_date.summary: ACI retrospective says the university was paralyzed since 27 Sep; onset remains in conflict with Adiac's 1 Oct report in the October unit.

notes: No public gathering is established in the consulted reports; this continuity record tracks a strike only. Cross-unit onset ref: congo_brazzaville_2024-10 / COB10S001.
